plan.title: Extend deft doctor with a precutover status line (Phase 0)

narratives.Description: The TypeScript doctor does not yet surface a pre-cutover detection line even though the predicates already exist in packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/precutover.ts. This story wires the existing isDeprecationRedirect and isCurrentGeneratedSpecification predicates into the doctor output as a short precutover line so operators see migration state without a Python port.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Import the existing precutover predicates into packages/cli/src/doctor.ts and add a precutover status line to the doctor report that reflects whether the project is pre-cutover.
- Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/doctor.test.ts that asserts the precutover line renders for a pre-cutover fixture and is absent for a current-layout fixture.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer running deft doctor, I want a precutover status line, so that I can tell whether a project still needs migration without reading the Python migrator.

items.title: Given a pre-cutover project fixture, when deft doctor runs, then the report includes a precutover line flagging the migration-needed state.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a pre-cutover project fixture, when deft doctor runs, then the report includes a precutover line flagging the migration-needed state.

items.title: Given a current-layout project fixture, when deft doctor runs, then the precutover line reports a clean non-pre-cutover state.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a current-layout project fixture, when deft doctor runs, then the precutover line reports a clean non-pre-cutover state.

items.title: Given packages/cli/src/doctor.test.ts, when the suite runs, then the new precutover-line assertions pass for both fixtures.
